title: campaign_view
description: A playback session against a campaign. Split from campaign because the audience is entirely different: consumers and anonymous visitors, never business staff. docs/17 section 4.

region.description: F2's hard wall (1.5.b adds the comparison rule against the principal's own region).

audience.description: 1.5.b's audience-targeting hard wall, same status as region above.

openViewingEnabled.description: Per-campaign opt-in, off by default (docs/17 section 4.2). An anonymous visitor may watch only when this is true.

openViewingBudgetRemaining.description: Qualified open views still funded. Zero means the bill is unfunded, and every delivered minute must belong to a funded campaign (docs/10).
